name: Multiple entities under common control
description: Several apparently separate businesses or sub-accounts share owners, signatories, addresses, devices or bank accounts.
fp: Genuine corporate groups share ownership; the concern is undisclosed linkage or cross-funding.

links.name: Sub-merchants sharing owners, devices or bank accounts
links.ctx: Many sub-merchants link to the same individuals or accounts.

links.name: Multiple cash businesses controlled by same people
links.ctx: Common owners or addresses across several cash businesses with cross-funding.

links.name: Accounts serving many unrelated clients with common controller
links.ctx: Multiple accounts or companies linked to the same controllers are used for flows of different, unrelated parties.

links.name: Multiple businesses sharing addresses, phones and bank signatories
links.ctx: A group of firms pooling workers share control and registered details with no group disclosed.
